items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training with a college-level program.
Masters Degree in related area
8 - 13 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory/managerial experience.
Oversees specific support functions of athletic programs, including scheduling and planning locations for sports events. (40% time)
Plans and coordinates programs and policy. (25% time)

Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive digital strategy that advances the mission, values, and brand of UC Riverside Athletics, with a focus on engaging key audiences including fans, donors, recruits, and the campus community. Provide strategic direction and oversight of all athletics digital platforms, including social media and content programs, ensuring alignment across all 17 sport programs and departmental initiatives. Supervise and guide staff responsible for day-to-day content creation, publishing, and platform management, establishing clear priorities, brand standards, and performance expectations. Drive a data-informed approach to digital engagement, audience growth, and revenue generation by setting measurable goals, evaluating performance metrics, and continuously refining strategy to maximize impact and visibility. Ensure that all digital storytelling and content initiatives reflect a cohesive, high-quality brand presence and effectively position UC Riverside Athletics within the conference and national landscape. (20% time)
Develops departmental budget. (5% time)
Coordinates compliance programs, student services and information systems units. (5% time)
Other duties as assigned. (5% time)

Strong leadership abilities and interpersonal skills to work effectively with a diverse client and peer group.
Working knowledge of the campus and/or medical center, including its achievements, mission, goals, vision, objectives and infrastructure
Ability to multi-task effectively; demonstrates sound judgment and decision-making; is an effective problem solver and effectively communicates verbally and in writing.
Working knowledge of order entry methods and techniques and related product knowledge
Advanced knowledge of the intercollegiate athletics function.
Significant knowledge of Microsoft Office. Extensive experience with Adobe Creative Suite and social media platforms outside of personal use.

Must maintain current knowledge of applicable rules and standards of the affiliated athletic conference, the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) or National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA), as well as other associations and agencies to which the campus adheres, and, at all times avoid any and all violations of these rules and standards.
Experience with video editing software.

Ability to foster positive relationships and create partnerships with a wide range of constituent groups; plan, develop, and coordinate multiple projects; work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, strong attention to detail and keep specific timeliness; and communicate and adhere to University, Big West Conference and NCAA policies, procedures, rules and regulations
Working marketing and sales knowledge.
Interpersonal communication skills to effectively deal with all levels of the organization and external constituencies.
Working knowledge of fundraising, donor and public relations principles, concepts, procedures and techniques, including identification, cultivation, and knowledge of solicitation strategies.
Demonstrated track record of creating remarkable customer service experiences.
Skills to implement and execute programs including skills to achieve predetermined goals and objectives within budget and time constraints.
Good written, oral and interpersonal communication skills and political acumen to establish and maintain good working relationships within all organizational levels and outside constituencies.
Project management, critical thinking, problem-solving and analytical skills, Strong organizational skills.
Skills to meet predetermined goals and objectives, including securing gifts.
Basic knowledge of applicable laws, rules, regulations, policies, etc.
Leadership/management skills, including skills to lead, direct, mentor, evaluate and motivate staff.
Skills to analyze evaluate and improve programs/services.
